title: 6.8 Graphs of Polar Equations

icans: I can test a polar equation for symmetry.
I can find the zeros and maximum |r| of a polar equation.
I can recognize and sketch limaçons and rose curves.

vocab: the __________ of r = a ± b cos θ or r = a ± b sin θ
the __________ of r = a cos nθ or r = a sin nθ, n ≥ 2
the __________ of r² = a² sin 2θ or r² = a² cos 2θ

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Symmetry tests: replace (r, θ) with (r, −θ) for the polar axis, (r, π − θ) for the line θ = π/2, and (r, θ + π) or (−r, θ) for the _______________.

blocks.stem: Test r = 3 + 2 cos θ for symmetry.

notes: Zeros and maximum |r|: find the θ-values where r = 0 and where |r| is _______________.
Rose curves r = a cos nθ or a sin nθ: n petals if n is odd, _______________ petals if n is even; each petal is |a| long.

blocks.stem:
Describe each rose curve.
a.  r = 2 cos 3θ
b.  r = 3 sin 2θ

notes: Limaçons r = a ± b cos θ: a/b < 1 inner loop; a/b = 1 _______________; 1 < a/b < 2 dimpled; a/b ≥ 2 convex.

blocks.stem:
Classify each limaçon.
a.  r = 2 + 2 sin θ
b.  r = 1 + 2 cos θ
c.  r = 3 + 2 cos θ
d.  r = 5 + 2 cos θ
Classify r = 3 − 3 sin θ, give its symmetry, and find its maximum |r|.

tickets.stem: How many petals does r = 5 sin 4θ have?
